animations.name: pacman_right
animations.description: Pac-Man facing right with mouth animation (frame 0=open, frame 1=closed)
animations.visualHint: Yellow circle with wedge cut out. Frame 0: wide wedge (open mouth). Frame 1: thin slit (closed mouth).

animations.name: pacman_left
animations.description: Pac-Man facing left with mouth animation
animations.visualHint: Mirror of pacman_right. Yellow circle, wedge cut out on left side.

animations.name: pacman_up
animations.description: Pac-Man facing up with mouth animation
animations.visualHint: Yellow circle, wedge cut out on top side.

animations.name: pacman_down
animations.description: Pac-Man facing down with mouth animation
animations.visualHint: Yellow circle, wedge cut out on bottom side.

animations.name: pacman_death
animations.description: Pac-Man death animation - shrinking to nothing
animations.visualHint: 8 frames showing Pac-Man progressively shrinking and fading away.

animations.name: ghost_red
animations.visualHint: Red ghost shape with white eyes and blue iris. Wavy bottom. Frame 0/1 alternate for floating effect.

animations.name: ghost_pink
animations.visualHint: Pink ghost shape with white eyes and blue iris. Wavy bottom.

animations.name: ghost_cyan
animations.visualHint: Cyan/light blue ghost shape with white eyes and blue iris. Wavy bottom.

animations.name: ghost_orange
animations.visualHint: Orange ghost shape with white eyes and blue iris. Wavy bottom.

animations.name: ghost_frightened
animations.visualHint: Blue ghost shape with simple dot eyes and wavy mouth. No iris detail. Wavy bottom.

animations.name: ghost_frightened_end
animations.description: Frightened ghost ending - flashing white/blue (2 frames)
animations.visualHint: Alternating frames: one white ghost, one blue ghost. Flashes to warn power mode ending.

animations.name: ghost_eyes
animations.description: Eaten ghost - just eyes returning to ghost house
animations.visualHint: Just two white eyes with blue iris, no body. Moves quickly back to ghost house.

animations.name: pellet
animations.description: Small dot pellet - basic score item
animations.visualHint: Small light-pink/white circle, about 4px diameter centered in 32x32 frame.

animations.name: power_pellet
animations.description: Power pellet - pulsing larger dot that lets Pac-Man eat ghosts
animations.visualHint: Larger circle that pulses between full size (~12px) and smaller (~6px). Warm white/peach color.

animations.name: wall
animations.visualHint: Dark blue filled square (32x32) with lighter blue border. Represents maze walls.

animations.name: empty
animations.visualHint: Fully transparent 32x32 tile. Used for walkable areas without pellets.

animations.name: ghost_door
animations.description: Ghost house door - ghosts can pass, Pac-Man cannot
animations.visualHint: Horizontal pink/white bar across the middle of the tile. Semi-transparent.
